build_glm_image_pipeline: build a GlmImagePipeline instance that composes denoising and decoding stages for multimodal image generation
create_pipeline_stages: create pipeline stages with GlmImageBeforeDenoisingStage and DenoisingStage using ServerArgs configuration
configure_pipeline_modules: configure required pipeline modules including text_encoder, tokenizer, vae, transformer, and scheduler
add_denoising_stage: add a DenoisingStage with transformer and scheduler modules to the pipeline
